title: Tata Power Company Ltd — Press Release
text: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 27, 2026, titled "Press release titled "Tata Power Renewables Powers Tata Steel's Decarbonization Journey with 72.5 MW Captive Solar Project in Rajasthan".
